narrative.overview: edge behaves like a small instrument mounted at the edge of a trader's workspace. It keeps Hyperliquid positions or the core BTC, ETH, and SOL markets continuously available without competing with the work already on screen. Its identity comes from progressive disclosure and a single anchored geometry.
keyCharacteristics: Four-state disclosure: notch, rail, inspector, expanded board, with Positions and Market lenses in the same geometry.
Graphite instrument surfaces with one mint live voice.
Tabular financial figures that do not shift as prices update.
Authored asset marks and explicit freshness/demo truth.
Native controls, keyboard paths, and Reduce Motion behavior.

rules.name: The Semantic Separation Rule
rules.body: PnL color and liquidation-risk color are calculated independently; profitability never implies safety.

rules.name: The Stable Figure Rule
rules.body: Every changing financial value uses monospaced or tabular digits and numeric content transitions.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: Window size may change, but its chosen screen edge and vertical context do not.

rules.name: The One Floating Body Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to free-floating utility surfaces; edge-clipped notch and rail surfaces use tone and fine rules without shadows.

dos: Do preserve the notch → rail → inspector → expanded disclosure sequence across Positions and Market.
Do keep financial values aligned with tabular digits and update only the affected position.
Do pair market colors with signs, labels, direction text, or numeric distance.
Do label stale and synthetic states in words.
Do replace move and scale transitions with opacity or immediate changes when Reduce Motion is enabled.
Do use authored vector geometry for recognizable asset marks.
donts: Don't turn the utility into a general dashboard, chart surface, or trading terminal.
Don't add decorative animation, glow, or shadow to every internal component.
Don't use positive PnL color as a proxy for liquidation safety.
Don't let a state resize detach the utility from its selected screen edge.
Don't expose deferred features such as privacy mode or trading controls in the v0 interface.
Don't replace native control semantics with gesture-only interaction.
